snippet.title: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon Teaser
snippet.description:
Nuclear Engineer Tycoon is a nuclear power plant building and management game. You will build reactors, turbines, pumps, batteries, and generators. Build pipes to move steam, water, and other fluids, and wires to move energy making reactors and turbines work. Earn money and research advanced and larger reactors. Keep the reactor safe and free from disasters; disasters are costly. Buy uranium to transform into fuel pellets. Treat nuclear waste, manage employees to automate your nuclear power plant.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4214910/Nuclear_Engineer_Tycoon/

Wishlist on Steam.
